boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented recurring Touro ceremonies and school-specific observances across its New York academic community.

cards.title: Lander Colleges Annual Commencement
cards.subtitle: Touro’s undergraduate graduation ceremony
cards.notes: Follow the annual Lander Colleges commencement coverage to see the ceremony, graduate recognitions, and university speakers in context.
cards.short_summary: A long-running annual graduation observance for Touro’s Lander Colleges.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro reported its 50th Annual Commencement Exercises for the Lander Colleges in 2024.
cards.source_title: Touro's Lander Colleges Celebrates Achievements of 600 Graduates at 50th Annual Commencement
cards.access_notes: Ceremony attendance and guest access are event-specific; consult the university’s current commencement information.

cards.entity_name: Division of Graduate Studies Annual Commencement Exercises
cards.title: Graduate Studies Annual Commencement
cards.subtitle: Division-wide Touro graduation observance
cards.notes: Use the yearly Graduate Studies commencement story as a visual record of the procession, stage program, and graduating schools.
cards.short_summary: An annual ceremony bringing together graduates from Touro’s Graduate Studies division.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro states that its Division of Graduate Studies held annual commencement exercises for the Class of 2024.
cards.source_title: Graduate Division Commencement: 1,200 Degrees Awarded Touro’s Class of 2024
cards.access_notes: This is a scheduled university ceremony; participation and guest details vary by graduating class.

cards.title: Enter in the Graduate Processional
cards.subtitle: Division of Graduate Studies ceremony practice
cards.notes: Look for the formal entrance of graduates and school representatives in current commencement coverage before planning any attendance.
cards.short_summary: A documented processional that opens Touro Graduate Studies commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro documented 2024 graduates entering in a processional led by a Grand Marshall while “Pomp and Circumstance” played.
cards.source_title: Graduate Division Commencement: 1,200 Degrees Awarded Touro’s Class of 2024
cards.access_notes: Part of a formal commencement program, not a drop-in campus activity.

cards.title: Open Commencement with an Invocation
cards.subtitle: Graduate Studies ceremonial observance
cards.notes: Watch the official commencement account to understand how the invocation fits into the university’s formal graduation program.
cards.short_summary: A documented ceremonial invocation in Touro’s Graduate Studies commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s 2024 Graduate Studies commencement account says the ceremony included an invocation by Executive Vice President Rabbi Moshe Krupka.
cards.source_title: Graduate Division Commencement: 1,200 Degrees Awarded Touro’s Class of 2024
cards.access_notes: This occurs within the scheduled commencement ceremony; access is governed by the event organizer.

cards.title: Hear the Student Commencement Address
cards.subtitle: Annual Graduate Studies graduation role
cards.notes: Check the current program for the selected student speaker, then use Touro’s coverage to learn how the address anchors the ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A student speaker is selected each year to address Graduate Studies graduates.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro reported that each year a student from one of its five Graduate Studies schools addresses the graduating class.
cards.source_title: Leadership Grounded in Humanity: Touro University Celebrates 2026 Graduate Studies Commencement
cards.access_notes: The speaker selection and ceremony access are determined for each graduating class.

cards.title: Recognize Service at Lander Commencement
cards.subtitle: Undergraduate ceremony awards practice
cards.notes: Review the official Lander commencement report for the academic and community-service awards presented alongside degrees.
cards.short_summary: Lander’s annual commencement includes recognition for service and academic achievement.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s account of the 2022 Lander Colleges annual commencement says numerous community-service and academic-achievement awards were presented.
cards.source_title: Touro Celebrates 600+ Graduates at 48th Annual Commencement
cards.access_notes: Awards are part of the scheduled graduation program and are not a public walk-in activity.

cards.title: Touro University Annual Research Day
cards.subtitle: University research showcase
cards.notes: Use the official Research Day story to identify the featured work and any announced presentation or attendance details.
cards.short_summary: A recurring university event centered on student and faculty research.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro described its 2024 research showcase as “Touro University Annual Research Day.”
cards.source_title: Fighting Setbacks in the Pursuit of Knowledge: Touro University Annual Research Day Highlights Resilience and Persistence

cards.title: Science Olympiad at Touro University
cards.subtitle: STEM competition hosted by Touro
cards.notes: Follow the official event coverage for the participating schools and competition details before treating it as an open spectator event.
cards.short_summary: A Touro-hosted science competition involving local Jewish high schools.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s official stories listing identifies “Science Olympiad at Touro University” as a competition attracting local Jewish high schools.
cards.access_notes: Participation and viewing arrangements are event-specific; confirm directly with the organizer.

cards.entity_name: Touro Social Work Tikkun Olam Award
cards.title: Tikkun Olam Award Recognition
cards.subtitle: Graduate School of Social Work honor
cards.notes: Read the official award profile for the honoree’s service work and look for future school announcements about this recognition.
cards.short_summary: A named Touro Social Work recognition tied to leadership, compassion, and community impact.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s 2026 stories listing reports a Graduate School of Social Work student honored with the Tikkun Olam Award for leadership, compassion, and community impact.
cards.access_notes: Award timing and related events are announced by the Graduate School of Social Work.

cards.title: Complete a Sefer Torah at the Jubilee Gala
cards.subtitle: Touro’s 50th-anniversary ceremonial observance
cards.notes: View the university’s gala account and photos to see how Touro marked its fiftieth anniversary through a Torah-completion ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A documented Jewish ceremonial element of Touro’s fiftieth-anniversary gala.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro reported that its 50th-anniversary gala began with completing the writing of a Sefer Torah.
cards.source_title: Touro University Marks 50 Years at Celebratory Gala
cards.access_notes: This was a documented 2022 anniversary-gala observance; the source does not establish it as a recurring public event.

warnings: Touro University is a multi-campus system. Public sources did not substantiate ten recurring, campus-wide New York traditions; several cards document recurring ceremonies or named school observances, and the Sefer Torah completion was a one-time 50th-anniversary event.

The supplied tradition-only template requires ten documented school-specific traditions. Available official evidence was insufficient to verify ten recurring traditions without broadening the selection to recurring ceremonies and named observances.
